body:
When `onCreateInputView()` runs before theme initialization, it returns null and the framework can retain an empty input frame. Complete that deferred request once the first theme is ready, without forcing the keyboard to show.

Following the review feedback, `e009dc0b` removes redundant flag resets during destruction and flattens the pending-start condition. The remaining flags distinguish an actual deferred request from an unused service and a pending input-view start from one already finished. Only missing trees are created, since settings callbacks can already have created part of the UI. The new view uses the latest editor and current virtual-keyboard mode.

Validation for this revision:

- Single-file ktlint and patch checks pass.
- [Current upstream PR CI](https://github.com/osfans/trime/actions/runs/39897773613): 5/5 jobs passed; application unit-test and Lint tasks executed. This checks its recorded merge with upstream, rather than claiming an exact fork-tree APK or an exported testcase count.

[Source, checks and review scope](https://github.com/X2M7/trime/blob/599b26cfbbec22f753ce421fe1d7abf895cf7d00/doc/contribution-split/checks/review-slim-20261023/README.md) are kept outside the application patch. Standalone device acceptance remains pending; earlier Android startup observations used a combined T9 APK and remain historical. No new device, performance, Release or warning-free acceptance is claimed.
